sanskrit: cakṣurātamparamaṃ padamiti śrīsarvānandanāthaviracite sarvvollāse saptaviṃśatyullāsaḥvinā śaktiṃ na siddhyeta tasmāt śaktiṃ samāśrayettatra sthitā devatātmā sā śaktiḥ sarvapūjitātataśca sādhakaḥ śreṣṭho mūṣayedbahubhūṣaṇaiḥgurubhaktiratāṃ devi kulasādhanatatparāmānīya bahuyatnena jātibhedaṃ na cācaretathavā pānasaṃhṛṣṭāṃ cakramadhye samānayetathavā strīsamīpe vā yantraṃ kṛtvā prapūjayettatsamīpe kṛtaṃ yantraṃ tadājñābhāvamānataḥkāmarūpāt śataguṇaṃḥ samudīritamavyayamkulaniṣṭhaśca vipraśca tasyāḥ śuddhiṃ na cācaretśodhayet paraśaktiñca dvitvātmaikatvahetavegaṅgāyāmanadhaṃ] yathāśaktiśuddhiḥ prakartavyā yadaikātmā na cet śiveātmaśuddhe [j: ātmaśuddhiḥ] śaktiśuddhistasya siddhidūrataḥśakterdoṣaṃ tadā kutra svayaṃ tatraiva saṃlayaḥtasya śuddhiḥ kathaṃ bhadre manasā cintanaṃ [g: cintaya] yadijāhnavī yamunā vāṇī [g: vāri] sadā bhātīti jñānataḥsāśuddhiśced bhaveddeva tadāśuddhiśca devatāmanasā cet na śuddhiḥ syānmantraśuddhiḥ sudūrataḥpūrṇacakraṃ nacet tatra pūrṇānandaṃ naced yataḥpraṇamya devatāvuddhyā bhogapātraṃ pradāpayetuccastanīṃ kāmaratāṃ vidhavāñca prapūjayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00120 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tasyā yoniṃ laṅghayitvā tattvaṃ devyai nivedayetubhau ca duḥkhau parame paśupāśaniyantritauśukrapātaṃ prakartavyaṃ tasyā vākyānusārataḥtāvacca ramaṇaṃ kuryāt patanānte parityajetnivedya kāraṇāktaṃ hi bhakṣayenmanunā śiveiti śrīsarvānandanāthaviracite sarvollāse aṣṭāviṃśatyullāsaḥtasyā dīkṣā kathaṃ proktā vidhavā vā kathaṃ vadaānandena bhavet pūjyā sānandā vīravanditādīkṣitā sadhavā jñeyā yadyānandasamāśritāśivo'hamiti saṃjñātvā śrīcakreṣu ramet śivāmātmaśuddhe jagat śuddhamaśuddhe cāpyaśuddhakamātmā'śuddhe'pyaśuddhā sā sphāṭike rañjanaṃ yathāśakterdoṣaṃ mahādevi gṛhṇāti naiva sādhakaḥśakterdoṣaṃ na cācarettāsāṃ prahāraṃ nindāñca kauṭilyamapriyantathāstriyo devāḥ striyaḥ prāṇā eva vibhūṣaṇamtaddhastāvacitaṃ puṣpaṃ taddhastāvacitaṃ jalammahācīnadrumalatāveṣṭitaḥ sādhakottamaḥmahācīnadrumalatāveṣṭanena ca yatphalamśavāsanādhikaphalaṃ latāgehe praveśanamkāmānandaṃ vinā devi bhogamuktirna jāyateśaktiśuddhirna kartavyā yataḥ sveṣṭamayī priyesindūrarañjitāṃ kṛtvā mūlamantraṃ likhed bhagemantradīkṣaḥ vidhānena śaktiśuddhistu tatkṣaṇātpūjayitvā maheśāni bhogapātraṃ pradāpayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00120 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: raktapuṣpeṇa nirmañjya [gh: nirmajya] yonideśe niyojayetmama śaktiṃ kuru dvandvaṃ svāheti daśadhā japetbhogapātraṃ yadā deyaṃ tadā ramaṇamācarettenaiva manunā devi ṣaḍaṅge [gh, j: ṣaḍaṅgaṃ] nyāsamācaretsaptatirmantritaṃ kṛtvā pūtaṃ sarvaṃ bhaved dhruvamjuhuyāt kuṇḍalīvaktre mūlamantreṇa sundaribhogakāle maheśāni ājihvāntaṃ vibhāvayetmūlamantraṃ samuccārya juhuyāt kuṇḍalīmukhebhojanecchā bhavettasyā nirlipto jīvasaṃjñakaḥprayāti narakaṃ ghoramekaviṃśakulaiḥ sahaguruṃ smaran pivenmadyaṃ khādan māṃsaṃ na doṣabhākiti śrīsarvānandanāthaviracite sarvollāse ūnatriṃśadullāsaḥkāraṇasya kāraṇaṃ hi sambideti prakalpitamkasmāt pānaṃ kāraṇaṃ hi sambidānandabhāk naraḥbhāvāktaṃ sambidānandaṃ madyānandamabhedakambhāvānandeṣu deveśi muktibhāg jāyate naraḥtadā kaivalyamuktiḥ syāt satyaṃ satyaṃ na saṃśayaḥidaṃ jñānaṃ sambidotthaṃ muktyarthamubhayānvitamsadānanda] pradāyakamata eva mahādeva sambidāgrahaṇañcaretsarvadā parameśāna siddhyānandaṃ kvacit kvacitmadyānandaṃ kvacid deva parvaṇi madhupānayukśukle yadi pivenmadyaṃ ādyante sambidāṃ pivetśukle cādyaṃ pivet siddhiṃ kṛṣṇe cādyaṃ pivenmadhutvaritāyāstamodbhūtamityānandasya lakṣaṇam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00120 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: rājasīti kriyāśaktastāmasīti kriyācyutaḥtathā siddhiṃ vinā devi madyānandaṃ hi niścitamtataḥ śaktiṃ yajeccakre tataḥ siddhiṃ pivenmudāata eva pivet siddhiṃ śaktiyukto maheśvaritadante śaktisaṃyukte sambidā samayā bhavetsvecchācāre'pi ramaṇaṃ niṣedhavidhivarjitamśivodbhavaṃ yadā dravyaṃ śaktiḥ saṃhṛhya yatnataḥihaloke sukhaṃ bhuktvā yātyante paramāṃ gatimyaḥ karoti trisandhāyāyāṃ mama tulyo na saṃśayaḥsambidāsavayormadhye sambideva garīyasītadā dhyānamayī mūrtiḥ pratyakṣā bhavati dhruvamsamvidāsavayormadhye samvideva garīyasīdhyānena dhyeyaṃ yadrūpaṃ samvidā nitya [j: mukti] dāyikākriyāmārgī kriyāśaktaḥ śuddhe'pi vijayāṃ pivetoṃ brahmāṇyai [gh, j: brāhmaṇyai] namaḥ svāhāoṃ kṣatriyāyai namaḥ svāhāhrī/ vaiśyāyai namaḥ svāhāklīṃ [ch: hrī/] śūdrāyai namaḥ svāhāullāsānandini kande cidānandasvarūpiṇimanonmani madhu drākṣā khecarī vijayā jayāmūlañca daśadhā japtvā juhuyāt kuṇḍalīmukhesvamūrddhani pradātavyaṃ manunā ca pivenmudāsamvidā paramā vidyā bhogamokṣapradā śivāprāṇavallabhasādhakānāṃ sādhanārthe svayaṃ jātyabhisaṃyutā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00120 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: jñānināṃ jñānabhedena nānārūpā ca samvidādūṣaṇaṃ hi phalāktasya guṇaṃ jñeyaṃ hi tasya tulakṣaṇaṃ hi tathā stotraṃ mama sthāne prakāśayaanyathā samvidāṃ vidyāṃ pivedānandahetavepuṣpabhedena deveśi jātibhedaṃ vicintayetkarmanaṣṭe jātinaṣṭe'pi muktibhāksitayātha guḍenāpi pakvaiḥ kadalikairapitena sarveṇa vijayāṃ svīkuryāt sādhakottamaḥmahātejaskarī cakṣurdoṣādikavināśinīghṛtena madhunā dhatte vāgdevīvaśakāriṇīpittadoṣān śleṣmadoṣān madhunā saha nāśayetsitayātha guḍenaiva śūlaghnī pittanāśinīāmavātasamudbhūtagrahaṇīvinivāriṇīvalapuṣṭipradā caiva madhurasvaradāyinīprakāśitaṃ tava snehāt sarvāgameṣu [k: savatantreṣu] gopitamgurumantraṃ samuccārya caturthyantaṃ nivedayetiṣṭadevasya tanmantraṃ prajapan viharet kṛtītejasvī valavān vāgmī medhāvī priyadarśanaḥbhaviṣyati na sandeho dravyasyāsya niṣevaṇātsamvit prayogastenaiva kartavyaḥ sādhakottamaḥtolakambā dvitolambā tolakatrayameva vātasmāt pramāṇamātrāhi kartavyā siddhimicchatāprasādādacirādasyāḥ siddhirbhavati vāñchitādevi tvayāpi vidhinā pravidhīyatāṃ tatetāni samabhāgāni raudre śuṣkāṇi cūrṇayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00120 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ubhayośca samāṃ datvā sitāṃ tanmiśrayed dṛḍhampunaḥ śilātale piṣṭvā trisugandhiñca miśrayetcaturbhirmantrabhistāsāṃ śodhanaṃ samupācaretmantrasiddhistathā pūjājapasiddhirvarānanesatyaṃ satyuṃ maheśāni satyameva na saṃśayaḥekoccāraṇamātreṇa tāvacca [gh: bhavecca] lakṣakoṭayaḥyasmai kasmai na dātavyaṃ iti satyaṃ kuru priyeiti śrīsarvānandanāthaviracite sarvollāse triṃśadullāsaḥādhāre sthāpayet pātraṃ mṛtsthitaṃ mṛtyudāyakamathavā vartulākāraṃ trikoṇaṃ tripadānvitamviśvāmitramayañca kāmadamidaṃ haimaṃ tathā sphāṭikamādhāraṃ sthāpayettatra pātraṃ tasyopari nyasetpittalaṃ kāṃsyasambhūtaṃ matsyañcaiva ca pārvatirājatañca varārohe sarvarogavināśanamputravṛddhikaraṃ proktaṃ mauktikaṃ parameśvaripittalaṃ sarvadoṣaghnaṃ tāmrajaṃ kīrtivarddhanamnṛkapālaṃ mahāpālaṃ sarvakārye praśastakamśāntike prastaraṃ pātraṃ stambhane mṛnmayaṃ śiveviśvāmitraṃ mahāpātraṃ sarvakāryeṣu durlabhammatsyañca parameśvari]kāryabhede pātrabhedaṃ kuryāt sādhaka īśvarinṛ kapālasamudbhūtaṃ pātraṃ śuddhaṃ prakīrtitamtatkapālakṛtaṃ pātraṃ sarvaṃ tasya vṛthā bhavettasya muṇḍaṃ svayaṃ chedya mahāpātraṃ prakalpayettasya muṇḍodbhavaṃ pātraṃ mahāpātraṃ prakīrtitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00120 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mahāpātrakṛto rājā yataḥ śāstā maheśvarimama prītikaraṃ pātraṃ sādhakaprītidāyakamtvāṃ vinā tasya māhātmyaṃ ko vetti jagatītaleaśodhitaṃ hi yat pātraṃ kevalaṃ duḥkhadāyakamyonyaśuddhe maheśāni pātramātre'pyuśuddhakamsarvaṃ śuddhaṃ bhaveddevi yonijñānaṃ bhaved yadipūrayet [gh: pūjayet] kāraṇenāpi mūlena guruvākyataḥpūritāni maheśāni kāraṇena maheśvariiti śrīsarvānandanāthaviracite sarvollāse ekatriṃśadullāsaḥsthāpayet sarvapātrāṇi sāmānyārghakrameṇa tusthāpitāni ca pātrāṇi pūrayet kāraṇena tupūrvādyaṃ cottarāgraṃ vā divārātrau vibhedataḥuttarāyantu saṃsthāpya paścimāgraṃ maheśvariuttarāgraṃ paścimāgraṃ niśācakraṃ cared [gh: yajed] yaditripātraṃ parameśāni sthāpayenmanunā śiveyoginī valipātrañca śaktipātraṃ maheśvaripātraṃ navamamityuktaṃ caturvargaphalapradamyoginī vīrapātrañca valipādyaṃ hi saptamamyoginī - valipātrañca pañcapātraṃ maheśvaritripātrāṇi ca kartavyamekapātraṃ na kārayetmantrastasya vṛthā jñeyaḥ śaktikāryaṃ vṛthā yataḥniṣedhañca vidhiñcaiva vāmāyāṃ nāsti ced yataḥgurūpātrodbhavaṃ madyamekapātraṃ pivenmudātāvanmadyaṃ pived bhakto yāvat pānaṃ kramāt krmātpañcapātramidaṃ matam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00120 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pādyamācamanīyañca navamaṃ parikīrtitamśaktaye bhogapātrañca pūjāpātrād yajet śivāmśaktimātre śaktipātraṃ vīrāya vīrapātrakamśrīpātrādamṛtenanāpi yajedarghādinā priyebhogārthaṃ bhogapātrañca śaktaye ca pradāpayetvaṭukakṣetrapālebhyo valipātraṃ nivedayetpādyapātraṃ pade [gh: dadet] devyā mukhe ācamanīyakamkāraṇaṃ hi bhavet kāryaṃ śrīdevyāścaraṇāmbujemṛtabhāvaṃ parityajyāpyamaraḥ sādhako bhavetataśca sādhakāḥ sarve dadeyuḥ kāraṇaṃ mukhetadante sādhako devi [j: parameśāni] pivedoṣṭhādharaṃ madhunārīdehasaṃśritāhamamṛtapānamāśritāyathā dehasya duḥkhe'pi dehī bhavati duḥkhabhāksādhakasyāpi muktyarthaṃ pānāktā kāmukānvitāparā śrīkālikārūpā [j: strī-] śrīcakrapālane varāvarābhayakarā ghorārāvayuktā vibhūṣaṇānagnā mattā mahādevī siṃhapṛṣṭhe śavāsanālakṣa lakṣa samāyuktā śrīcakraṃ pālayet sadādarśane ghrāṇasaṃsparśe pānānandapradāyikākṛpānvitā]iti śrīsarvānandanāthaviracite sarvollāse dvātriṃśadullāsaḥsarvadevā na tṛpyanti smaraṇāt pūjanāt śivesarvadravyasamāyuktaṃ manunā pātrakaṃ dadetkapilānte jaṭābhāra bhāsurānte trinetra cavahnijāyānvito mantro vaṭukasya udāhṛtaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00120 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śāntiṃ karotu me nityaṃ bhūtavetālasevitaḥbhyaḥ svāhā sarvavarṇānte yoginīpadamālikhetanena manunā devi yoginīnāṃ balirbhavetkhecarīṣu bhūcarīṣu sā me prītāstu sarvadāsthānakṣetrapadaṃ pānadhūpadīpādi cālikhetvahnijāyānvito mantraḥ kṣetrapālasya sundariprīto'yaṃ balidānena sarvarakṣāṃ karotu mevarānte varadānte ca sarvānte janamālikhetvahnijāyānvito mantro gaṇeśasya valiṃ haretpātālatalasaṃsthāśca śivayogena bhāṣitāḥtṛpyantu prītimanaso bhūtā gṛhṇantvimāṃ balimyasya nāma pradātavyaṃ taddevo valimicchatigṛhṇa yugmaṃ dvidhāntoyaṃ manuḥ sarvaphalapradamrājarājeśvaro devo me prasīdatu sarvadādakṣāṃguṣṭhānāmikābhyāṃ yoginīnāntu kathyateanayā mudrayā devi kṣetrapālavalirbhavetrājarājeśvarī devo me prasīdatu sarvadākuladīpaṃ vinā bhadre jñānadīpaṃ nacet kvacitnivedyaṃ kena rūpeṇa kathaya prāṇavallabhadīpān ḍamarukārāñca bṛddhasya nakhamānataḥśatānyūne maheśāni yugmānyaṃ dīpa kalpanamdīpasaṃkhyāṃ paribhrāmya svatejastejasi layamśataṃ deyaṃ divā kārye kulaniṣṭhaśca sādhakaḥtridhā devyagre saṃbhrāmya kuladīpaṃ nivedayetāraktakāmadaṃ dīpaṃ gṛhāṇa mama siddhaye
source_edition: Muktabodha M00120 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pañcamaṃ saptamaṃ vāpi navamaṃ vā viśeṣakamtataḥ śaktiṃ yajet cakre yayā śaktyāyutaḥ śive [gh: priye]svaśaktiṃ paraśaktiṃ vā dīkṣitāñced yajet śivāmtriśūlamudrayā gṛhya pivedācāryavākyataḥpṛthak pātraṃ pradātavyaṃ madhunā saha bhairavibhairavāya pradātavyaṃ bhaktāya sevakāya caprāṇāyāmaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā gṛhṇīyāt pātramuttamamsvavidyokta ṛṣinyāsaṃ vyāpakanyāsameva catataḥ pātraṃ namaskṛtya juhuyāt kuṇḍalīmukheiti śrīsarvānandanāthaviracite sarvollāse tritriṃśadullāsaḥatisūkṣmatamanāmnaḥ prāṇāyāmasya kiṃ phalampañcāśanmanunā devi varṇanyāsaṃ samācaretkaranyāse karaṃ jñeyaṃ devasya karamātrakamvarṇanyāse maheśāni deho devamayo bhavetso'haṃ jñānena deveśi ṛṣyahaṃ paricintayettaddehaṃ devatārūpaṃ so'haṃ jñānaṃ sadā yadāsaptadhā nyāsajālena saptaite devarūpiṇaḥsaptadhā mantrayenmantrī kyāpakanyāsakaṃ śivebhaktyāpi yaddīyamānaṃ tad gṛhṇāti kuleśvariādhāre manunā sthāpya tarpayet tadanantaramguruśaktiṃ tarpayitvā sveṣṭadevīñca tarpayetgurorājñānusāreṇa tacchaktiramaṇañcaretgurorājñānusāreṇa pātraṃ dattvā kriyāñcaretvivāhaṃ bandhanaṃ jñeyaṃ vartistho vahnivat priyetasya vāme nārīmātraṃ ramaṇañca tadājñayā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00120 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tadājñayā ramet śaktiṃ mātṛbhāvaṃ parityajetśrīguroścaraṇaṃ dhyāyan svamūrdhni gurupādukāmānandabhairavaṃ devaṃ sveṣṭavidyāṃ hi tarpayetsahasrāre sveṣṭavidyāsahitaṃ tarpayed gurumabhede tarpayed bhadre [ch, j: bhadraṃ] sahasrāre mahāpureataśca tarpayeddevān tāntrike vaidikeṣu caśrīpādukāṃ tarpayāmi pūjayāmīti vā priyeparameṣṭhiguruṃ devi tarpayet tritrivārakamparāparaguruḥ ko vā parameṣṭhiguruśca kaḥnānārūpaṃ sthūlamātraṃ yathāgniḥ kāṣṭhasaṃyutaḥaikyaṃ kṛtvā sthūlasūkṣmaṃ sarvametat prakāśitamparāparagurustvaṃ hi parameṣṭhigururhyahamsavāhanāṃ sveṣṭadevīṃ tarpayāmi dvidhāantakaḥtarpayeccet kriyāsaṅgād guruṇā saha bhāvinīmśvetavarṇā dvibhujāktā dvinetrā tatsamāyutamtatsaṃyuktaṃ guruṃ dhyāyet tarpaṇādikamācaretaṃguṣṭhatarjanīyogād dakṣiṇe [j: dakṣeṇa] puṣpapātanamanayoryogamātreṇa dravyaṃ puṣpaṃ manoharamaṃguṣṭhayogāt sā devī puṣpitā kāmavihvalātarpayed yonimadhye tu yoniṃ saṃgṛhya tatparambindumātreṇa dravyeṇa tuṣṭā bhavati kāminītarpaṇādi prakartavyaṃ jalamāyā sanātanītathā toyaṃ sarvapūjyaṃ sarvasya bandhamuktidamtarpayed jñānavān devi svamūrdhni hṛdaye ca vāguṇatrayasya caikatve tarpaṇaṃ caikavārakam

sanskrit: sṛṣṭi bījaṃ hi oṃkāraṃ laya bījaṃ trilocanedakṣiṇānāñca vāmānāṃ siddhāntānāṃ maheśvarikaulānāñcaiva divyānāṃ bhāvātītaṃ hi kevalamiti śrīsarvānandanātha viracite sarvollāse ūnaṣaṣṭyullāsaḥprakāśite'pi kaulānāṃ divyānāṃ bhedakaṃ vadaubhayoreka bhāvena bhāvātītamayo bhavetdivya vīre ca yo bhedaḥ sa bhedaḥ parikathyatemātrabhedakam]tejaḥ syāt paramāṇuśca sarva vyāpinirañjanamprasaṅgāt kathayāmyadya divyasyāpi ca lakṣaṇamtejomayaṃ jagat sarvaṃ vibhāvya mūrtti kalpanam [j: kalpitam]ṣaṣṭyullāsaḥidaṃ vīra kulaṃ devi jñeyaṃ ramyaṃ manoharamprakāśa vākyaṃ nirdvandvamekaṃ hrasvaṃ hi dīrghakamguruṃ laghuṃ dīrghaṃ vācātītaṃ vacaḥ śivejñānaṃ jñeyamayaṃ śivejñānajñeyaṃ mano devi bhāvātītaṃ sunirmalambhāvātitād bhavedbhāvo bīja vṛkṣeva pārvatiata eva maheśāni mano'tītaṃ nirañjanamsadā kāmena sā bhāti kalārūpā sanātanīcākhyānakīrttanaṃ]kalā ca dvividhā proktā guptā vyaktā maheśvariśmaśāna vāsino vīrāḥ kalāṃ pūjanti sarvadāiti c: pustakīyapāṭhaḥ |] yajedvīraḥ śmaśāne gopane śivevyaktāpi (?) pūjayedvīro vāhye'pi nirjane priye

sanskrit: udāsināṃ śmaśānañca gṛhiṇāmarccayedbhagamśavārūḍhāt tathā devi bhagārūḍhādhikārakaḥcitā vyaktāpi deveśi guptayonīti kīrtitākalāvāsava yogena kalā pūjāṃ prakalpayetmaithunena vinā devi madyapānaṃ na cācaretgatāsūnaśavaḥ prokto madya pānāsavaḥ priyeśavāsane bhedakāryamabhedamāsavāsaneśaktidarśanamātreṇāpyudāsināṃ kriyā kṣayaḥpuruṣasyāsanaṃ śaktiḥ śakteḥ puruṣa dehakamiti śrīsarvānandanātha viracite sarvollāse ekaṣaṣṭyullāsaḥvṛthā pūjā bhavettasya na bījaṃ jala secanamśaktisaṅgamam]vṛthā jñānaṃ bhavettasya śaktiṣu śaktisaṅgamamte brahmajñāninaḥ santaḥ prakṛtiṃ puruṣātmakamubhayorjñānayogena brahmajānīti niścitamubhayorekabhāvena brahmajñānīti niścitamsaiva yoni svarūpā ca [gh: sā] jagadutpatti kāriṇībrahma viṣṇu śivādīnāṃ mūlāḥ sattvādayo guṇāḥsthūla sūkṣmamayaṃ jyotirvyāpitā prakṛtiḥ sthitāvācakam]punaḥ pralīyate yasyā [gh, j: tasyāṃ] tasyāśca jāyate punaḥvikṛtiḥ prakṛtimāpanne tataḥ kiñcinna paśyatinādhikāritāḥ; j: nādhikāriṇaḥ]triguṇe'pyekabhāvo'pi guṇaśca kena jāyateekabhāvena prakṛtiścaṇakākāra rūpakaḥ

sanskrit: vibhinne śiva śaktiḥ syādabhinne caṇakaḥ śivekṣitiḥkaṃ] pāvako dhruvamtriguṇa [j: trikoṇa] vyāpitaṃ sarvaṃ jagat sthāvare jaṅgamamnirguṇasyālayaḥ sākṣānmahākālyālayaḥ priyesūkṣmadeha [j: dehe] samudbhūtā puṃdeheṣu prakāśitāubhāvubhau ca saṃtyaktvā kṣaṇamātra na tiṣṭhatisākāraṃ yadbhaveddevi kevalaṃ bodha hetavedṛśyate parameśāni tathā sarvamidaṃ jagatsākāraṃ yadi jāyeta svecchayāpi tadā priyesākāraṃ svecchayā tasyā nirākārañca svecchayāyadā ced bahudhā bhūtā [j: bhūtvā] tadā jyotīti kīrtitābahunā [gh, j: bahudhā] ramaṇenāpi cābhāve bhābabodhakamrūpatrayaṃ bhāvabodhaṃ sṛṣṭi sthiti layaḥ priyepuruṣaṃ śivebhagañca prakṛtiṃ jñeyaṃ pumān brahmeti pārvatisarvadā vāyunā devi tatra śṛṅgārakāvubhaupāñcabhautikaḥ [gh, c: -bhautikam]kaula jñānamidaṃ devi kalpātītaṃ nirañjanamiti śrīsarvānandanāthaviracite sarvollāse dvāṣaṣṭhyullāsaḥkaivalyaṃ kīdṛśaṃ jñānaṃ kathaya prāṇa vallabharaverutpadyate toyaṃ toyādutpadyate mahīaṇḍajaḥ svedajaścaiva udbhijjaśca jarāyujaḥvṛkṣa gulmādayo devi udbhijjāhi hi vicetanāḥteṣāṃ madhye manuṣyeṣu brahmajñānañca jāyatetannāśe parameśāni sūkṣmadehī prakāśitaḥ

sanskrit: kṣitirjalaṃ tathā tejo vāyurākāśa eva caśravaṇaṃ darśanaṃ ghrāṇaṃ sparśanaṃ rasa bodhanamcaturviṃśati tattvāni śaktiratra pṛthak pṛthakadhunā śrotumicchāmi tattat śaktyanukīrttanamgadituṃ naiva śaknomi brahmāṇḍānte'pi pārvatitāsāṃ madhye śreṣṭha [j: sṛṣṭi] rūpā caturddaśa parātmikāśaktiruktā maheśvaritridhaikoktā [gh: tridhaikātmā] kriyātmikāvināhaṅkāramātreṇa kiñcinmātraṃ na jāyateahaṅkārasya nirlepādahaṃ brahmeti bhāṣyateyathātathā deho maheśāni dehimadhye prakāśitaḥtaraṅga budbudau nāśe toyamātraṃ na saṃśayaḥdehanāśe tathā deho kevalo'haṃ nirañjanaḥ [j: niraṃjanam]prabodhe tu pare tattve kevalo'haṃ nirañjanaḥ [g, j: -nam]saṃsthitampralīnaṃ hi punastasmin kṣitau vṛkṣeva [j: brahmaiva] pārvatisṛjyate ca punastasmāt [gh: tasmin] svecchayā nija māyayāsarvaṃ hi khalvidaṃ brahma tadanyannāsti kiñcanasthāvaraṃ jaṅgamaṃ vyāptaṃ praṇamāmi jaganmayamkriyātītaṃ kriyāyuktaṃ sarvaṃ vyāpyaika saṃsthitamnirvikāraṃ vikārāktaṃ sarvaṃ vyāpyaika saṃsthitamyajajñānānnāparaṃ jñānaṃ tadbrahme tyavadhārayetravirvilīyate vāyau vāyurvilīyate ca kheśivo vilīyate śaktau tato brahma nirūpaṇam
